headline: CHC @ COL matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is CHC 5.83 at COL 5.00, with a projected total of 10.83. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward COL: CHC moved +0.01 runs while COL moved +0.74, changing the projected margin by -0.73 runs. The projected total climbed +0.76, which points to more offensive expectation than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability rose +8.3%, so the first-inning read became more pitcher-friendly early. Pitching context: Ryan Feltner has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 2.2 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Pete Crow-Armstrong, Jake McCarthy, Michael Busch, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Chad Stevens, Michael Conforto because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
